decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute because it was opened too late. TXN-007904 is a charge of 1413.00 EUR at HARBOUR GADGETS on card CRD-000193. It was posted on 2026-06-13, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26. That is 135 days later. The time-limits section requires a dispute to be opened within 120 days of posting, and says the limit applies even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. The approval for the charge, AUTH-008113, does suggest fraud: it was an online payment with 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, no security code given (CVV NOT_PRESENT), and the bank's fraud flag set. Under the policy order the time limit is checked first, so these signals cannot change the outcome. The cardholder's statement contained no instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the date a transaction is posted. This charge was posted on 2026-06-13 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, which is 135 days later. The time limit applies even when a transaction shows signs of fraud.
